entries.title: Job 17:1
segments: ¶"My spirit is broken, My days are extinguished, The grave [is ready] for me.

entries.title: Job 17:2
segments: [Are] not mockers with me? And does not my eye dwell on their provocation?

entries.title: Job 17:3
segments: "Now put down a pledge for me with Yourself. Who [is] he [who] will shake hands with me?

entries.title: Job 17:4
segments: For You have hidden their heart from understanding; Therefore You will not exalt [them].

entries.title: Job 17:5
segments: He who speaks flattery to [his] friends, Even the eyes of his children will fail.

entries.title: Job 17:6
segments: "But He has made me a byword of the people, And I have become one in whose face men spit.

entries.title: Job 17:7
segments: My eye has also grown dim because of sorrow, And all my members [are] like shadows.

entries.title: Job 17:8
segments: Upright [men] are astonished at this, And the innocent stirs himself up against the hypocrite.

entries.title: Job 17:9
segments: Yet the righteous will hold to his way, And he who has clean hands will be stronger and stronger.

entries.title: Job 17:10
segments: ¶"But please, come back again, all of you, For I shall not find [one] wise [man] among you.

entries.title: Job 17:11
segments: My days are past, My purposes are broken off, [Even] the thoughts of my heart.

entries.title: Job 17:12
segments: They change the night into day; 'The light [is] near,' [they say], in the face of darkness.

entries.title: Job 17:13
segments: If I wait [for] the grave [as] my house, If I make my bed in the darkness,

entries.title: Job 17:14
segments: If I say to corruption, 'You [are] my father,' And to the worm, 'You [are] my mother and my sister,'

entries.title: Job 17:15
segments: Where then [is] my hope? As for my hope, who can see it?

entries.title: Job 17:16
segments: [Will] they go down to the gates of Sheol? Shall [we have] rest together in the dust?"
